card.source_span: On 15 June 2025, Thai prime minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra contacted Khleang Huot, deputy governor of Phnom Penh, to request his assistance as an interpreter and intermediary for an informal conversation with Cambodian Senate president Hun Sen.
